newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Venezuelan woman decapitates 6-year-old daughter.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan woman decapitates 6-year-old daughter.

text.p: A Venezuelan woman decapitated her 6-year-old daughter and hid the remains in plastic bags, Costa Rican police said on Monday.
"It was dreadful. Tears came to my eyes when I saw the naked body and the little head tossed aside in another bag," police officer Elmer Thomas told journalists.

A police report said the woman wanted to get rid of her daughter "in order to live a different life." The remains were found on Sunday morning in the Rio Macho tourist zone about 22 miles (35 km) east of San Jose.
The woman was identified as Mariela Hernandez Davila, 27, who had entered Costa Rica from Panama a week earlier. Police identified the victim as Cristal Austil Hernandez.

Investigators were tipped to the crime by a taxi driver who told police Hernandez asked to be taken to Rio Macho to drop off garbage that she was carrying in plastic bags. The driver, Alejo Berrocal, said he began to suspect foul play when he helped the woman with her bags, which "were very heavy and warm," he told police, according to the report.
Hernandez later was arrested aboard a bus. No charges were filed pending a court hearing.
"She was acting as if nothing had happened," another police officer said, requesting anonymity. "She said this was something normal that happens all the time in Europe."
